summary: The manuscript reports a preregistered paired experiment (study cand-2026-03) evaluating template-based input sanitization + deterministic verifier-gating (with ≤1 automated repair) on synthetic adversarial NetOps intents using gpt-5-mini and deterministic_netops_validator_v5. Analysis artifacts show 141 complete pairs with baseline acceptance 135/141 and guarded 141/141; paired difference ≈ 0.04255, exact McNemar p = 0.03125, 95% bootstrap CI [0.01418, 0.07801]. The experiment, preregistration, execution, and analysis artifacts appear complete and internally consistent. However prior required manuscript fixes (condensing Disclosure and removing run-internal paths/hashes and raw DOI/URL inline citations) have not been addressed in the submitted manuscript text. These provenance and citation-format issues must be corrected before finalisation.
critical_issues: Disclosure Statement and Methods/Results still include run-internal file paths and full artifact hashes in prose rather than a concise high-level disclosure plus a single IEEE-numbered citation to the archived execution manifest.

Manuscript prose (Methods, Results, figure/table captions) contains raw DOI/URL/run-path strings and in-line DOIs/URLs instead of standard IEEE numeric citations; several in-text citations are presented as raw links/DOIs rather than numbered references that must be verified to support the adjacent scholarly claims.

References and in-text citation semantics are not presented in standard IEEE numbered format; the manuscript must ensure each numbered citation actually supports the claim it is attached to (verify against the supplied terminal_bibliographic_records).
required_revisions: Condense the Disclosure Statement to the mandatory high-level elements only (models used, orchestration adapter, autonomy-lock boundary, preregistration hash, protocol deviations, artifact-availability statement). Remove per-file paths and full hashes from the manuscript body and Disclosure; replace them with a single IEEE-numbered citation referencing the archived execution manifest (the archive contains the full hash manifest). This change can be made using the supplied execution_manifest artifact.

Replace all run-internal file paths, artifact filenames, and full hashes appearing in Methods, Results, figure/table captions, and the Disclosure with a single IEEE-numbered citation to the execution manifest or to an archival artifact bundle entry. Do not include ordinary run-level paths or full hashes in the manuscript body; retain full provenance in the archived artifact bundle cited by the manifest.

Convert every raw DOI/URL/inline link in narrative prose to standard IEEE numeric citations. Ensure the bibliography entries use standard IEEE formatting and that each in-text numeric citation points to the referenced work whose verified metadata is present in the provided terminal_bibliographic_records (fix any citation–claim mismatches so each cited reference actually supports the nearby claim).
optional_revisions: Add a brief sentence in Discussion emphasizing practical interpretation given the ceiling effect (guarded=100%) and small discordant count (n10=6) to aid operational readers.

Provide a short high-level table (or point via IEEE citation to an archived table) enumerating the six discordant pairs with simple diagnostic labels (sanitizer-only vs repair-applied); keep detailed traces in the archive rather than in the paper.

In Methods/Disclosure, explicitly recommend the provider sampling parameter for deterministic reproduction (e.g., temperature = 0) and cite the execution manifest entry where the current unset temperature is recorded.
